description: Cutover step P2: declare the two fleet classes and create their applications, re-uploading the live PoolWorker code byte for byte. The one step that cannot be undone. The root's row also plans as an update whose only other difference is its attachment, while the pool Worker updates. On this step that is by design, every time: a class new to the pool Worker has no namespace yet, so the provider does not promise the Worker's class map, and the planner cannot know the root's attachment until the Worker applies. The same row also comes from a setting that waits on a row in the same plan, such as the pool database command's outcome. It is admitted only when the namespace it resolves to is already recorded, equal on both rows, and the pool Worker still hosts the class; the apply then reads the application and sends nothing.
